svg.text: Bulkhead: 6 mm disc welded inside the cage's front end, 12.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre hole for the pull rod and an 8 mm hole for the load

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cell cable, 18 mm right of and 15 mm above the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ring: 80 mm OD x 3 mm, welded on the cage's rear end, four

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5.5 mm holes on a 66 mm circle to match the housing flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End cap: 80 mm OD x 6 mm disc, the same four holes, a 12.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre hole for the pull rod's tail and an 8 mm cable hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lined up with the bulkhead's (fit a small cable gland).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
